defs.def: behaving in a kind and pleasant way because you like sb or want to help them 友爱的；友好的

ex.s: Friendly animals can get food more easily.
ex.t: 我开始满怀激情地练习小提琴，进步迅速。

ex.s: Dogs can tell “being friendly” from “being mean”
ex.t: 狗可以将“友善”与“为人所欲为”区分开来。

ex.s: Friendly interactions light up the day.
ex.t: 友好的互动点亮了一天。

ex.s: Emoji can help communication feel friendlier, and even a serious note can be softened with an encouraging smile.
ex.t: 表情符号能让沟通显得更友好，即使是严肃的留言，加上一个鼓励的微笑也能变得柔和。

ex.s: F Studies show that friendlier communication leads to a happier workplace
ex.t: F 研究表明，更友好的沟通会带来更快乐的工作场所

ex.s: But that doesn't stop them having a friendly argument about which word is the “right” one!
ex.t: 但这并不妨碍他们就哪个词才是"正确的"进行一次友好的争论！

ex.s: She always seemed happy and friendly.
ex.t: 她总是看起来快乐和友善。

ex.s: While some of the people looked very friendly, some of them looked so dangerous.
ex.t: 虽然有些人看起来很友好，但有些人看起来十分危险。

ex.s: With its beautiful views, mild climate and friendly people, Vancouver is known as both a popular tourist attraction and a good place to live in.
ex.t: 温哥华以其美丽的景色、温和的气候和友好的人们而闻名，既是一个受欢迎的旅游景点，也是一个宜居之地。

ex.s: The staff is friendly and helpful, providing you with a map of the city when you arrive, and offering advice if you require some.
ex.t: 工作人员是友好和有帮助的，为您提供到达时的城市地图，如果您需要一些建议，也会提供建议。

ex.s: On social media sites, people tend to post only positive updates that make them appear happy and friendly.
ex.t: 在社交媒体网站上，人们倾向于只发布让他们看起来快乐和友好的积极更新。

ex.s: However, new studies have shown that dogs can read human behaviour and have a preference to people who are more friendly or generous with food.
ex.t: 然而，新研究表明，狗能读懂人类行为，并偏好那些更友好或对食物更大方的人。

ex.s: They rose in the ranks not by being friendly but by smoking cigarettes, breaking rules and playing jokes on others, among whom I soon found myself.
ex.t: 他们在队伍中的崛起不是因为友好，而是因为抽烟、违反规则和取笑别人，我很快就发现自己就在别人中间。

defs.def: showing kindness; making you feel relaxed and as though you are among friends 善意的；亲切的；和蔼可亲的

ex.s: The arrival of driverless vehicles is a chance to make sure that those vehicles are environmentally friendly and more shared.
ex.t: 无人驾驶汽车的到来，是确保这些车辆环保且更共享的机会。

ex.s: Though friendly, he could easily knock over my niece’s small boys and my six-month-old granddaughter.
ex.t: 虽然他很友善，但他很容易撞倒我侄女的小男孩和我六个月大的孙女。

defs.def: treating sb as a friend 朋友似的
not treating sb/sth as an enemy 尤指国与国之间的关系
that is helpful and easy to use; that helps sb/sth or does not harm it 常构成复合形容词
in which the people, teams, etc. taking part are not seriously competing against each other （比赛）为增进友谊的；非对抗性的

chunks.cn: 感到快乐的 与 友爱的
友爱的 与 有用的
